description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's rename detection capabilities. It includes setup steps, invoking Git commands to create test cases, and verifying diff outputs related to rename detection logic in Git. The script sources external scripts for test utilities and diff helpers, and defines a series of test scenarios for rename/copy detection.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with a description.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw_z
methods.description: Compares the raw diff output in z format against expected output.
